samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>A 4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier with two levels of registers to store intermediate values and control the multiplication process.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 4 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 4 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size" value="4">Size parameter for the multiplier.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="mul_a_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplicand signal with 4 additional zero bits at the MSB positions.</assign>
        <assign id="mul_b_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplier signal with 4 additional zero bits at the MSB positions.</assign>
        <assign id="partial_products" width_description="[7:0][3:0]">Array of 4-bit partial products generated based on the multiplier bits.</assign>
        <assign id="sum_reg" width_description="[7:0][3:0]">Register array to store intermediate sums during addition stages.</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Extend inputs to be able to use them in the loop
        assign mul_a_ext = {{(size){1'b0}}, mul_a};
        assign mul_b_ext = {{(size){1'b0}}, mul_b};
        
        genvar i;
        generate
            for(i = 0; i < size; i=i+1) begin : gen_partial_products
                assign partial_products[i] = mul_b_ext[i] ? (mul_a_ext << i) : 'd0;
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Add partial products
        integer j;
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                for(j = 0; j < size; j=j+1) begin
                    sum_reg[j] <= 0;
                end
            end else begin
                for(j = 0; j < size; j=j+1) begin
                    sum_reg[j] <= partial_products[j];
                end
            end
        end
        // Final product calculation
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                mul_out <= 0;
            end else begin
                mul_out <= sum_reg[0] + sum_reg[1] + sum_reg[2] + sum_reg[3];
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
